message.body: The billing page rewrite (ct-418) is ready to open as a pull request except for one call that is yours, not mine. The Starter and Team plans were retired on 2026-09-15, but customers already on them keep their price until renewal. Do I keep a short "legacy plans" section on the page (the two names and a line saying existing customers keep their terms, no prices), or drop the old plans from the page entirely? I cannot open the pull request until I know. Reply here with `cast send`.
